title: DocSizeChecker Feature Config
description: Three-level size check for documentation files. Unit: lines or chars.

unit.description: Measurement unit: line count or character count.

best.description: INFO threshold — over this suggests trimming.

x-docs.intent: Warn when doc files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md) exceed size thresholds. Default unit is lines (200/300/500). Switch to chars for Claude Code MAX_MEMORY_CHARACTER_COUNT alignment (30000/40000).
x-docs.notes: best < warn < error required. Returns null when at or below best threshold. Per-file check, not aggregate.
